locations.note: In the prologue Bishop Parrey hides the coded parchment in the college library, moments before the sect's commandos reach him.
At the Hamburg docks a stranger bumps into Nina and dies moments later, just before she boards the cruise ship Calypso.
Strange accidents pile up aboard the Calypso until a giant wave capsizes the ship.
Max photographs an ancient temple on a small Indonesian island, saves the kidnapped Sam Peters and is captured after the sect's bomb sets off an eruption.
Washed ashore, Nina and vicar David Korell search the ruins of Gatineau for the key named in a dying nun's letter of 1681.
Nina and vicar David search a cardinal's secret archives in Paris for the sect's prophecies.

routes.name: Nina Kalenkov
routes.note: From Hamburg aboard the Calypso until it sinks in the North Sea, ashore to the ruins of Gatineau and on to Paris.
